## Biography

Nadya Holdstock is a fuel specialist aboard the Distant Worlds 3 expedition, described as a "fuel wizard" with her ponytail tucked under a service cap. She monitored Jasmina Halsey's SRV from low orbit in her Asp Explorer during the Guardian ruins investigation on Praei2, later deleting footage of the obelisks reacting to Halsey before showing her the recording. Holdstock analysed Halsey's recovered escape pod, identifying it as ancient super-cooled nitrogen technology that should have been impossible to keep operational — with no nitrogen present and no power source detected.
